qaSummary: 40 identities and all 170 recorded color images rendered; 210 displayed images loaded with zero broken files.
4 accepted with one exact color and variant selected: one top, two bottoms, and one outerwear identity.
36 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of 17 promising color variants.
Accepted colors are coffee, khaki, light blue, and camel; the set adds warm and bright options without relying on black or navy.

Rejections include unproven hanger-only shirts, visible branding, redundant band-collar roles, puddled corduroy and sweatpants, long cargo shorts, synthetic product-only trousers, dated racing leather, novelty camo and dark generic outerwear.
